lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Defrain | Lesson 6 -- First Coffee

listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome to the Corner Café. My name is Leo. Today's special is a coffee and a piece of chocolate cake, for six pounds. Our tea is from India, and it is very good with milk. Please order at the counter. Thank you, and have a nice day!

Here is a coffee tip for London. A white coffee is a coffee with milk. A black coffee is a coffee without milk. In a café, you order at the counter, and then you say your name. They write your name on the cup. So, say it slowly, or spell it!

extra_audio.text: Bruna goes into a small café. She asks for the menu. She orders a coffee with milk. She orders an egg sandwich and an orange juice. She says her name for the cup.

lesson.pre_a1_modelo: I'd like a coffee with milk, please.
lesson.grammar_point: a / an + I would like (I'd like) to order
